items.a: Muslim children ages 5–16, from KG through Youth Group (Grades 9–10). Children join the grade they attend at weekday school; KG students must be 5 and in kindergarten.

items.q: Does my child need to read Quran already?
items.a: No for younger grades. Students are expected to read Quran by Grade 4 and know salah by Grade 6, so older new students may need some catching up at home.
$800 per child per year, including all books and snacks. You can pay in two installments, and confidential financial aid is available.

items.q: Can we visit a class first?
items.a: We don’t hold open-house classroom visits, but you’re welcome to email us with any questions.
